RG STEP b CLASSIFY: persistent = {k : |gain_k - 1| < eps_gain} (expect 8-core, e0 and e_{d/2}); void = remaining (2d-8)/2 pairs
RG STEP c BALANCE: rotate each xor-4 pair to drive Sigma tilt -> 0 (stable-manifold approach; Oblique-Gear T6)

RG STEP e RESCALE: r_scale <- r_scale / d*_taut; x <- x * r_scale
RG STEP f RECORD: d*_k <- d* on the rescaled core; history.append
LOOP until |d*_k - d*_{k-1}| < eps OR d > D  ->  d*_RG := lim d*_k
